default_hyperparameters.status: stability-admissible reference configuration; evaluated by the Reviewer-aligned validation sensitivity and not claimed globally optimal
default_hyperparameters.hyperedge_size_rule: for anchor i and nearest visible demand r: min k>=2 such that anchor capability plus the k-1 largest other public fleet capabilities reaches r; fallback k=2 when no task is visible; positive CLI value is diagnostic override
default_hyperparameters.wave_update: Z[q+1] = (1-damping) Z[0] + damping (I - tau L_H) Z[q]
default_hyperparameters.wave_sufficient_stability_condition: 0 < damping < 1 and 0 < tau <= 1 because spectrum(L_H) is contained in [0,1]

main_ablation_rationale.selection_rule: All three component controls are evaluated on the same two retained scenarios, dynamic_overload and scale_20.
main_ablation_rationale.coverage_constraint: 3 variants x 2 retained scenarios x 5 seeds = 30 variant jobs
main_ablation_rationale.dynamic_overload: Tests capability-aware reassignment, refinement under seed-jittered task arrivals, and sparse-versus-complete communication under overload.
main_ablation_rationale.scale_20: Tests the same three mechanisms with 20 agents and 380 directed non-self candidate links.

main_ablation_references.rule: Reuse the five-seed full-method main-scenario results; do not retrain duplicate full controls in the ablation launcher. Join only by scenario, training seed and checkpoint identity, and never select between repeated full runs.

claim_rule: The three redesigned scenarios are audit-driven and require fresh runs for every method; legacy results under the same IDs are obsolete. A setting may be called empirically best only after all fixed seeds finish under identical budgets, and all failures remain in the analysis.

sensitivity_protocol.selection_rule: Report every prespecified wave-iteration and damping value on consensus_wide using paired five-training-seed statistics. The main comparison retains the frozen default.
sensitivity_protocol.analysis_role: Wave-depth and damping sensitivity within the proved contraction range.
sensitivity_protocol.design: One-factor-at-a-time on consensus_wide; the reference reuses the five main-experiment checkpoints and performs a fresh frozen evaluation.
sensitivity_protocol.default_checkpoint_reuse_rule: Resolve exactly one PASS consensus_wide checkpoint for each formal training seed, perform zero optimizer updates, and evaluate on seeds 901--905.

scenario_rationale.consensus_wide: Staged task release changes active coalitions within an episode and directly exercises refinement depth and damping.

sensitivity_protocol.k1_degeneracy_rule: K_w=1 is an identifiability control: the implemented filter depends on the product delta_w*tau_w. The formal default is K_w=2.

one_factor_design.reviewer_role: K_w depth and K_w=1 degeneracy control
delta_w sensitivity inside the contraction interval
